latest_release.name: eCapture v2.10.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* docs: refresh project logo assets by @cfc4n in https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/pull/1071
* docs: refresh embedded logos in project images by @cfc4n in https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/pull/1072
* build: unify release builds and reuse binaries in Docker by @cfc4n in https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/pull/1073
* ci: configure a dedicated LoongArch runner by @cfc4n in https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/pull/1074
* build: use LLVM 22 for LoongArch builds by @cfc4n in https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/pull/1075
* ci: run LoongArch E2E on push and trusted pull requests by @cfc4n in https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/pull/1076
* gnutls: support measured 3.8.10 through 3.8.13 layouts by @cfc4n in https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/pull/1077
* *: consolidate documentation and legacy test coverage by @cfc4n in https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/pull/1078
* ci: stream LoongArch E2E output directly in Actions by @cfc4n in https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/pull/1079
* *: improve pcapng text output and verify QUIC v1/v2 by @cfc4n in https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/pull/1080
* decrypt: revert v1.4.0 integration for PR review by @cfc4n in https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/pull/1081
* decrypt: integrate v1.4.0 protocols and live capture validation by @cfc4n in https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/pull/1082


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/gojue/ecapture/compare/v2.9.1...v2.10.0
